messages:
rachel: Heads-up: canary promotion for sessions-chart v5.0.0 is failing health checks in us-west small pool. deploy-bot reports readiness probe timeouts after values bump.

deploy-bot: promotion blocked — 2/4 pods failing readiness probes (timeout) in namespace sessions-canary. failing check: readiness `/healthz` timed out. holding further promotions.

ethan: I noticed the values change included `session.gcInterval: 5s` (previously 60s) and `feature.experimentalSessionStore: true`. aggressive GC + new store could be flapping readiness while migrating stores.

priya: also the chart changed the liveness/readiness timeouts in the same patch (`readiness.initialDelaySeconds: 5` -> 2). suspect combining shorter probe delay with heavy GC is causing transient failures.

rachel: we need to decide: 1) rollback to v4.9.3, 2) pin the canary to v4.9.3 and patch chart, or 3) adjust in-cluster values temporarily to broaden probe windows and re-run canary.

infra-oncall: if it's just probe tuning, option 3 is low-impact and fast, but it means the chart in the git tag stays at v5.0.0 and could get re-promoted later. safer: rollback + annotation so deploy-bot won't auto-promote until we remove pin.

priya: I'm +1 for rollback and pin. We should avoid changing live values that mask a real regression. We'll patch the chart to make GC idempotent and keep the probe sensible before re-promote.

product: fyi - v5.0.0 enabled the experimental session store that the mobile team wanted for sticky sessions. They asked for a canary today. If we rollback, let them know the feature will be delayed.

rachel: ok consensus: rollback to v4.9.3 and pin. I'll prepare the release note and a short announcement to mobile.

ethan: rollback commands and annotations:
```
kubectl annotate namespace sessions-canary release-management/hold=true --overwrite
kubectl annotate namespace sessions-canary release-management/pinned-chart=v4.9.3 --overwrite
helm rollback sessions-release 7 --namespace sessions-canary
```

deploy-bot: manual action recorded: rollback requested by @rachel for release sessions-release -> target chart v4.9.3. Promotion hold applied.

priya: I'll open a patch PR to make the migration idempotent, restore `readiness.initialDelaySeconds` to 10 by default, and gate `experimentalSessionStore` behind `values.features.experimentalSessionStore: false` default. ETA 5h.

rachel: rolling back now, will add changelog entry: "Reverted sessions-chart to v4.9.3 due to readiness flapping with v5.0.0 session GC/migration. Hold applied until session-store migration is patched."

deploy-bot: helm rollback successful. release sessions-release -> v4.9.3. Promotion hold remains until annotation removed.

infra-oncall: I'll monitor canary metrics and watch for any pod churn. Once patch PR merges, we should run a tiny canary in the dev pool first and schedule re-promote outside peak hours.

product: thanks for moving quickly. please add an item in #release-notes for the mobile team so they're looped in.

rachel: will do. thanks all. :white_check_mark:
